def make_base(self):
    self.model = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .moveTo(0, 0)
        .lineTo(self.leg_length, 0)
        .lineTo(self.leg_length, self.thickness)
        .lineTo(self.thickness, self.thickness)
        .lineTo(self.thickness, self.leg_length)
        .lineTo(0, self.leg_length)
        .close()
        .extrude(self.beam_length)
    )
